description: Presidential  Secretariat - Order to appoint Mr. M. Kingsly Fernando as Secretary to Minister of Disaster Management
categorisation: This gazette content announces the appointment of a specific individual (Mr. M. Kingsly Fernando) to a government position (Secretary to the Ministry of Disaster Management). It includes the person's name and the date of the appointment but provides no details about the portfolio responsibilities, duties, or functions of the ministry. This fits the definition of a People Gazette (Type 2), which covers government personnel changes without detailed portfolio descriptions.
